name: const unsafe fn offset_from_unsigned (self , subtracted : NonNull < T >) -> usize where T : Sized ,
rule: For `offset_from_unsigned(self, subtracted)` to be safe, `self` and `subtracted` must either point to the same address, or both be derived from a pointer to the same allocated object with the entire memory range between them in bounds of that object; this requirement applies both at compile time and at runtime.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn offset_from_unsigned (self , subtracted : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T >) -> usize where T : Sized , }
